description: Surfaced in Arc 4 op-disc close (PR #27, 2026-05-23). The save-verdict skill wrote a verdict RECEIPT under a generic filename (argus-rev2-reconfirm.txt) that OVERWROTE the Arc-45 receipt of the same generic name. PLINY caught it and reverted to preserve the Arc-45 receipt, committing only properly-named arc-47 records (the actual verdict .md was safe — only the receipt collided). FIX: save-verdict should namespace receipts per-arc or per-ticket (e.g. <arc>/<seat>-<phase>.txt) to prevent cross-arc overwrite. Skill-hygiene note; sibling tooling-finding to stoa--7ap (both surfaced during the debloat engagement, both non-blocking, both for a future hardening pass).

comments.text: RELATED FACET (Arc 5 PLINY cut, PR #28, 2026-05-23): sub-agent file-WRITE location hazard, same root cause as the receipt collision. ARGUS (a sub-agent) ran save-verdict and the file resolved to MAIN ROOT, not the arc worktree — because sub-agents inherit the PARENT session cwd (no per-subagent cwd override; cf. the subproject-Read finding). PLINY caught it and moved the verdict + receipt into the worktree pre-build. So save-verdict (and any sub-agent file write) has TWO hygiene problems: (1) filename collision across arcs [original finding], (2) write resolves to main root not the worktree [this facet]. A robust save-verdict should write to an explicit per-arc worktree path AND namespace per-arc. Both belong to the same hardening pass.

title: save-verdict skill: receipt filename collision — generic names overwrite prior arcs' receipts; namespace per-arc/ticket
